title: Claude Fable 5.1 requests fail in Cursor with Privacy Mode on until data retention is approved
symptoms: Requests to Claude Fable 5 or 5.1 fail for an Enterprise team or a Privacy Mode user
Some Fable requests are answered by Claude Opus instead
cause: Fable 5 and 5.1 need provider-side data retention, which falls outside Cursor's zero retention agreements. For Enterprise customers and anyone with Privacy Mode on, requests fail until an admin approves the model's retention policy; requests that trip a Fable guardrail are rerouted to Opus.
fix: Have an admin approve the model on the dashboard restricted models page, which applies to the whole team, or pick another model.
affected: Cursor, Claude Fable 5 and 5.1, Enterprise and Privacy Mode accounts, as of 2026-10
